title: GUARD (fixed in c67727aaa8) — was: `_files -g '*.txt'` reached from a `zle -C` widget: zsh errors and inserts the .txt match, zshrs completes a directory

setup: local curcontext="$curcontext" state state_descr line ret=1
spec.completer:
#compdef fzc0007

local curcontext="$curcontext" state state_descr line ret=1
typeset -A opt_args

_arguments  \
  '*::arg name: _files -g '\''*.txt'\''' && ret=0

return ret

retired.fix_commit_subject: fix(compsys): `_files` split its file-patterns on whitespace where upstream evals them
retired.why: the native _files port (src/compsys/ported/Unix/Type/_files.rs) split the -g pattern on whitespace where Unix/Type/_files:83 runs it through `eval`; the eval'd `*.txt:globbed-files` now raises zsh's `(eval):1: no matches found` and takes the same fallback, so the `alpha.txt` insert and the diagnostic this fixture recorded as only-zsh now happen on both.
retired.evidence: re-verified first-hand by scripts/compsys_regressions.py --variants --confirm-moved 3 at 0b11157986: the fixture cell scored NOW-PASSES four times (both shells report `no matches found: *.txt:globbed-files`), and every variant/control agreed. The runner reported the binary CHANGED since the stamp (6420c23cecc13c35 -> dde9ed4252d2e7e5), the 'somebody fixed the bug' branch the README names.
retired.kept_because: a fixed bug is worth more as a guard than as a deleted file: the cell stays in the evidence base and the gate now FAILS if the divergence comes back.

guard_verified.against: debug build of 0b11157986 with c67727aaa8 reverse-applied (113783920 bytes, sha256 6065a3c25e9a7518) — carries the bug

It reported CONTROL-MOVED with the same harness detail observed_when_diverging records, so the guard fails on THIS bug.

observed.measured: 2026-09-14, commit 0b11157986, a codesigned byte-identical copy of target/debug/zshrs passed with --zshrs (zshrs 0.12.64, 113648832 bytes, sha256 dde9ed4252d2e7e5) vs zsh 5.9.2 (aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0)
observed.notes: both shells report `no matches found: *.txt:globbed-files`; the grids agree.

observed_when_diverging.notes: The widget's function IS the completer body, so there is no _main_complete frame above it. zsh reports `(eval):1: no matches found: *.txt:globbed-files` and still inserts `alpha.txt`; zshrs reports nothing and inserts the directory `adir/`, which the -g glob excludes. Two one-sided facts in one cell: the diagnostic only zsh emits, and the match set.
